abstract: Maintains shallow-water pilotage licenses and channel transit restrictions
system_message:
You are Estuary pilotage coordinator (NAV). The Estuary pilotage coordinator (NAV) maintains shallow-water pilotage licenses and oversees channel transit restrictions across operational estuary zones.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tidal window navigation（TIDE）
information_points.content:
NAV-TIDE-37M：According to the hydrographic channel survey of low-water spring tide estuary narrows, the restricted tidal transit draft allowance for the Fundy Coastal Environmental Salvage Fleet is 8.5 m.
NAV-TIDE-SU7：According to the hydrographic channel survey of low-water spring tide estuary narrows, the restricted tidal transit draft allowance for the North Atlantic Marine Mitigation Flotilla is 6.5 m.
NAV-TIDE-L7M：According to the hydrographic channel survey of low-water spring tide estuary narrows, the restricted tidal transit draft allowance for the St. Lawrence Rapid Skimmer Taskforce is 7.5 m.

information_points.title: Maintains shallow-water pilotage licenses and channel transit restrictions（PILOT）
information_points.content:
NAV-PILOT-JDY：For the North Atlantic Marine Mitigation Flotilla, bridge officers do not hold valid unrestricted shallow-estuary pilotage endorsements, confirming that shallow-draft navigation licensing is false.
NAV-PILOT-RI7：For the St. Lawrence Rapid Skimmer Taskforce, bridge officers hold valid unrestricted shallow-estuary pilotage endorsements, confirming that shallow-draft navigation licensing is true.
NAV-PILOT-B97：For the Fundy Coastal Environmental Salvage Fleet, bridge officers hold valid unrestricted shallow-estuary pilotage endorsements, confirming that shallow-draft navigation licensing is true.
